records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: Net sales for the third quarter of fiscal 2025 increased 7.2% to $3.72 billion from $3.47 billion in the third quarter of fiscal 2024.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: The increase in net sales was driven primarily by the 3.9% increase in comparable store sales, as well as new store openings and the contribution from Allivet.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: We usually experience our highest inventory and accounts payable balances during our first fiscal quarter for purchases of seasonal products to support the higher sales volume of the spring selling season, and again during our third fiscal quarter to support the higher sales volume of the cold weather selling season.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: As a percent of net sales, gross margin in the third quarter of fiscal 2025 increased 15 basis points to 37.4% from 37.2% in the third quarter of fiscal 2024.

records.title: 10-Q TRACTOR SUPPLY COMPANY
records.text: Operating income for the third quarter of fiscal 2025 increased 5.6% to $342.7 million from $324.6 million in the third quarter of fiscal 2024.
